title: golden_key.json
description: Machine identity the golden belongs to (MG3 / ROADMAP 2.3). A mismatch means the golden was made on another game variant or GPU: the watcher refuses to apply or adopt and shows SAFE MODE. A missing key is treated conservatively as a match (legacy install).

variant.description: 'GTA V' or 'GTA V Enhanced' - detected from the install path.

created.description: ISO timestamp of when the key was recorded.
